units.source: Resetting your password
units.context: Resetting your password

units.source: If you forget your password:
units.context: Resetting your password

units.source: Protected notes are irretrievable without the password.
units.context: Resetting your password

units.source: Unprotected notes can be recovered.
units.context: Resetting your password

units.source: There are two options, both involving access to the device that is running your server.
units.context: Resetting your password

units.source: By disabling authentication__TRILIUM_PH_0__
units.context: Resetting your password > By disabling authentication

units.source: See __TRILIUM_PH_0__Authentication__TRILIUM_PH_1__ on how to disable the authentication.
units.context: Resetting your password > By disabling authentication

units.source: Restart the server.
units.context: Resetting your password > By disabling authentication

units.source: Go to __TRILIUM_PH_0__Options__TRILIUM_PH_1__ → Password → Reset password.
units.context: Resetting your password > By disabling authentication

units.source: Re-enable authentication by following step (1) in reverse.
units.context: Resetting your password > By disabling authentication

units.source: Restart the server.
units.context: Resetting your password > By disabling authentication

units.source: Log in with the new password.
units.context: Resetting your password > By disabling authentication

units.source: By altering the database__TRILIUM_PH_0__
units.context: Resetting your password > By altering the database

units.source: Access the __TRILIUM_PH_0__database__TRILIUM_PH_1__ file in the __TRILIUM_PH_2__data directory__TRILIUM_PH_3__. Open the __TRILIUM_PH_4__ file with an SQLite client (e.g., __TRILIUM_PH_5__DB Browser__TRILIUM_PH_6__).
units.context: Resetting your password > By altering the database

units.source: Execute the following queries:
units.context: Resetting your password > By altering the database

units.source: After executing the changes, commit/write the changes. __TRILIUM_PH_0__This sets the password to__TRILIUM_PH_1__ __TRILIUM_PH_2____TRILIUM_PH_3__, allowing you to log in again.__TRILIUM_PH_4__
units.context: Resetting your password > By altering the database

units.source: Go to __TRILIUM_PH_0__Options__TRILIUM_PH_1__ → __TRILIUM_PH_2__Password__TRILIUM_PH_3__ → __TRILIUM_PH_4__Change password__TRILIUM_PH_5__ and replace the unsafe password.
units.context: Resetting your password > By altering the database
units.translation: __TRILIUM_PH_0__Options__TRILIUM_PH_1__ → __TRILIUM_PH_2__Password__TRILIUM_PH_3__ → __TRILIUM_PH_4__Change password__TRILIUM_PH_5__ に移動し、安全ではないパスワードを置き換えます。

units.source: Handling protected notes__TRILIUM_PH_0__
units.context: Resetting your password > Handling protected notes
units.translation: 保護されたノートの扱い__TRILIUM_PH_0__

units.source: When the password is reset, the protected notes are permanently lost due to the fact that they are encrypted with your password so there is no way for Trilium to recover them.
units.context: Resetting your password > Handling protected notes
units.translation: パスワードがリセットされた場合、保護されたノートはあなたのパスワードで暗号化されているためTriliumで復元する方法がなく、完全に失われます。

units.source: For pre-existing protected notes (now unrecoverable), consider deleting them or exporting the unprotected notes. Then, delete __TRILIUM_PH_0__ and start fresh.
units.context: Resetting your password > Handling protected notes
units.translation: （現在復元不可能となっている）既存の保護されたノートについては、削除するか、保護されていないノートをエクスポートすることを検討してください。その後、__TRILIUM_PH_0__ を削除して新しくやり直してください。
